lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of circular, high-luminance blobs located posterior to the gill slits. The spots are most densely clustered anteriorly and increase in spatial interval towards the posterior mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible grid-like structure of anchor nodes across the central lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature is visible running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with light intensity on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge.
